title: 第17章 我要耕田种地第18章 李长贵又来了
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
张婶不仅模样不怎么样，这身材更不怎么样。
不仅膀大腰粗，肌肤都已经失去了胶原蛋白，松松垮垮的，没有一点诱人的地方。
“傻大炮，张婶这有大白馒头，你吃不吃？”
张婶故意调戏李大炮，她似乎觉得孟晚晴已经先下手为强，她也不能落后。
李大炮完全提不起兴趣，吃过叶秋玲的馒头，对张婶家的馒头已经完全不感兴趣。
“张婶，虽然我是个傻子，但是你也别骗我，这根本不是馒头。”
李大炮一本正经的说道，他完全没有心动的意思，只想着如何才能脱身。
张婶有些不好意思了，刚好外面好像又有动静，连忙重新系上了扣子。
“真是个傻子呀。”
张婶开口感叹，她觉得要是换一个正常的男人，只怕早就已经扑上来了。
她去厨房灶上拿了两个馒头给李大炮，随后说道：“大炮，今天谢谢你了，我家的柴火都已经劈好了，你先回去吧。”
李大炮眼前一亮，他要的就是张婶的感谢。
在他的期待下，功德葫芦果然有了动静，又多了一滴绿色的灵液，没有让他失望。
“怪不得叫功德葫芦，只要我不停的做好事，应该就可以得到更多的功德灵液。”
李大炮激动万分，这可是发财致富的宝贝，他拿起一个馒头咬了一口，出门就撞到了赵婶。
“大炮，跟我回家，我家的炕烧不热了，帮我去清一下炕灰。”
赵婶说道，随后一把拉住李大炮的手，把他拉走了。
时间一晃，直接来到了晚上。
孟晚晴在田地里找到了李大炮，看着他还挥汗如雨的帮别人挖着地，不得不怀疑，他真的脑袋缺根筋。
“大炮，你疯了，这么拼命的帮别人干活干什么？”

孟晚晴啐道，干完活给两个馒头就打发了，一个个也太欺负人了。
她现在住在李大炮的家里，那么李大炮就是她的人，她可以欺负，不能让别人也这样欺负。
“呃，她们都是女人，干不动什么重活，我刚好精力旺盛，有力气没地方使，王大娘说我就适合耕田种地，还说什么家里还有田，让我晚点回去耕。”
李大炮开口忽悠，关于功德葫芦的事情，自然不能跟孟晚晴说。
这是他现在最大的秘密，谁也不能说。
孟晚晴立即红了脸，在牛犊子村待了一天，入乡随俗，似乎学到了不少虎狼之词。
换做之前她也许还听不明白，但这一刻却是秒懂了。
“这个王大娘，年纪一大把了，还这么不正经。”
孟晚晴啐道，随后抓住李大炮的锄头，不让他干活了。
“媳妇，马上就要干完了。”
“那也不能干了，等明天再干。”
“好吧，那我去找王大娘，她说她家里还有田要耕。”
李大炮故意装傻，因为今天的所作所为在别人眼里确实有些古怪，必须装傻。
孟晚晴被成功忽悠了，觉得李大炮真的如他所说，时不时会犯病。
今天明显就犯病了，而且还非常严重。
“听我的，不去了。”
“都已经说好了。”
“说好了也不准去，自己家里还有田要耕呢。”
孟晚晴红着脸说道，这是真的入乡随俗，她都能说出这样的虎狼之词。
李大炮无可奈何，不过也不要紧，今天已经收获了好几滴绿色的灵液，够他培养出一大批新鲜的黄瓜。
content_en:
Aunt Zhang not only looks bad, but her figure is even worse.
Not only do I have big shoulders and a thick waist, but my skin has lost its collagen, making it loose and unattractive.
"Silly Cannon, Aunt Zhang has some big white steamed buns here, do you want to eat them?"
Aunt Zhang deliberately teased Li Dapao. She seemed to think that Meng Wanqing had taken the initiative and she could not fall behind.
Li Dapao was completely uninterested. After eating Ye Qiuling's steamed buns, he was no longer interested in Aunt Zhang's steamed buns.
"Aunt Zhang, although I am a fool, don't lie to me. This is not a steamed bun at all."
Li Dapao said seriously. He had no intention of being moved at all and was only thinking about how to get out.
Aunt Zhang felt a little embarrassed. There seemed to be some movement outside, so she quickly buttoned up her clothes again.
"What a fool."
Aunt Zhang sighed. She felt that if she had been a normal man, she would have pounced on him long ago.
She went to the kitchen stove and took two steamed buns to Li Dapao, and then said: "Dapao, thank you for today. My firewood has been chopped. You can go back first."
Li Dapao's eyes lit up, what he wanted was Aunt Zhang's thanks.
In response to his expectations, the Gourd of Merit did indeed move, adding another drop of green spiritual liquid, which did not disappoint him.
"No wonder it's called the Gourd of Merit. As long as I keep doing good deeds, I should be able to get more merit liquid."
Li Dapao was extremely excited. This was a treasure that would make him rich. He picked up a steamed bun and took a bite. He bumped into Aunt Zhao when he went out.
"Cannon, come home with me. The kang in my house is no longer hot. Help me clear the ashes."
Aunt Zhao said, then grabbed Li Dapao's hand and pulled him away.
Time passed by and it came directly to night.
Meng Wanqing found Li Dapao in the field. Seeing him digging the ground for others while sweating profusely, she had to suspect that he really had a weak head.
"Cannon, are you crazy? Why are you working so hard for others?"
Meng Wanqing spat, after finishing the work, just giving it to two steamed buns was too much of a bully.
She now lives in Li Dapao's house, so Li Dapao is hers. She can bully her, but she cannot let others bully her like this.
"Well, they are all women and can't do any heavy work. I happen to be very energetic and have no place to use my strength. Aunt Wang said that I am suitable for farming. She also said that there is still land at home and asked me to go back to work later."
Li Dapao started to lie. Naturally, he couldn't tell Meng Wanqing about the merit gourd.
This is his biggest secret now, and no one can tell it.
Meng Wanqing immediately blushed. After spending a day in Niuduzi Village, she followed the locals and seemed to have learned a lot of words about tigers and wolves.
She might not have understood it before, but she understood it instantly at this moment.
"This Aunt Wang is very old, but she is still so unruly."
Meng Wanqing spat, then grabbed Li Dapao's hoe and stopped him from working.
"Daughter-in-law, we will be done soon."
"We can't do it anymore. We can wait until tomorrow."
"Okay, then I'll go find Aunt Wang. She said she still has fields to cultivate at home."
Li Dapao deliberately pretended to be stupid, because what he did today was indeed a bit weird in the eyes of others, so he had to pretend to be stupid.
Meng Wanqing was successfully deceived and felt that Li Dapao was really as he said and would fall ill from time to time.
I obviously fell ill today, and it was very serious.
"Listen to me and don't go."
"It's all been agreed upon."
"You're not allowed to go even if you agree. I still have fields to plow at home."
Meng Wanqing blushed and said, this is really like doing as the Romans do, she can say such arrogant words.
Li Dapao was helpless, but it didn't matter. He had harvested several drops of green spiritual liquid today, which was enough for him to grow a large number of fresh cucumbers.
